features: PREMIUM PROTECTIVE CASE: MOCA case is made from lightweight PU leather with a hard shell, offering protection for All-New 7 inch Kindle Paperwhite 12th Gen and Kindle Colorsoft. MOCA case is made from lightweight PU leather with a hard shell, offering protection for All-New 7 inch Kindle Paperwhite 12th Gen and Kindle Colorsoft.

AUTOMATIC WAKE/SLEEP FUNCTION: This Kindle Paperwhite case features smart auto wake/sleep technology. It automatically wakes your device when you open the cover and puts it to sleep when closed, saving battery life. Enjoy hassle-free reading with no extra button pressing needed, making it a great accessory for Kindle Paperwhite 12th Generation

MAGNETIC CLOSURE FOR SECURE FIT: The case comes with a strong magnetic closure that keeps the front cover securely closed. This prevents accidental opening and protects the screen from damage. It fits perfectly for Kindle Paperwhite 12th Gen and Kindle Colorsoft Signature Edition, making it a reliable and stylish accessory for your device

SLIM AND LIGHTWEIGHT DESIGN: Designed specifically for the 7-inch Kindle Paperwhite 12th Gen and Kindle Colorsoft 2024 & 2025 edition, this MOCA case is slim and lightweight. It adds minimal bulk while offering full protection. The precise cutouts allow easy access to buttons, ports, and charging without removing the case, enhancing your reading experience

COMPATIBILITY AND STYLE: Designed for All-New Kindle Paperwhite 12th Generation (7 inch) and Kindle Colorsoft Signature Edition (1st Gen 2025 Release). Models SA569P, SA568B, SA59CP. Stylish, protective, and available in multiple colours.
